verdict.rationale: The Gmail API documents server push notifications that let a program watch for mailbox changes and that notify your backend server application whenever a mailbox changes. That is a first-party, programmatically consumable event subscription. Only a few thin doc snippets support it, with no detail on how to register, what payload arrives, which event types exist, or how delivery works. Missing for 10: documented registration/watch setup and payload format, granular event types beyond 'mailbox changes', and independent or hands-on corroboration of the push mechanism.
